create.name: Katrina Bos
create.bio:
Katrina Bos is a Canadian teacher of tantra, Kundalini yoga and meditation who lives and teaches in Goderich, on the shore of Lake Huron in Ontario. She came to this work by a winding road: a mathematics degree from the University of Waterloo, years as a farmer and mother, and a spell running a dance studio where she taught ballroom, Latin and bellydance. Kundalini yoga has been at the centre of her practice for about twenty years, and she once ran her own studio, East Street Station, as well as teaching in hospitals, shelters and workplaces.

Her approach to tantra is down to earth: she presents it as a way of bringing spiritual awareness into ordinary life and close relationships rather than a set of exotic rituals. Through Satya Yoga Academy she leads an online 200-hour Kundalini teacher training, weekly classes on Zoom and seasonal classes in Goderich. Her self-paced courses cover tantric intimacy for singles and couples, the masculine and feminine, and the spiritual side of tantra, and she offers one-to-one sessions built around Energy Grids, her own chart of how a person is wired through the chakras. Her books include Tantric Intimacy and Divine Union of the Masculine & Feminine, along with memoirs about travel and online dating.

books.title: Tantric Intimacy: Discover the Magic of True Connection
books.author: Katrina Bos
books.description: Her first book on tantra, told largely through stories from her own life as a mother, partner and seeker. It presents tantra as an everyday philosophy of closeness and honesty that anyone can explore, whatever their background.

books.title: Divine Union of the Masculine & Feminine
books.author: Katrina Bos
books.description: A rethinking of what masculine and feminine energies mean once the old stereotypes are set aside. She looks at how the two can play together within a person and between partners, and what real union might look like.

books.title: Tales from the Tinderverse: A Tantrika's Journey in the World of Online Dating
books.author: Katrina Bos
books.description: A light-hearted memoir of her time on dating apps, seen through the eyes of someone who teaches tantra. The stories mix comedy and surprise with what each encounter taught her about connection.

courses.title: Journey of Awakening
courses.description: A one-to-one programme of eight private sessions over four or eight months, opening with an Energy Grid reading and then working through the chakras one at a time. Between meetings you receive a personal daily practice and reflection questions recorded for you.

courses.title: Breakthrough Session
courses.description: A long one-to-one conversation, in person or on Zoom, that starts from your Energy Grid and follows whatever is keeping you stuck without watching the clock. It usually runs one to two hours.

courses.title: Energy Grid Readings
courses.description: An hour-long reading of your Energy Grid, Katrina's chakra-based chart of how you are wired, looking at your gifts, challenges and patterns. A longer couples version compares two charts side by side.

courses.title: Energy Grid Training
courses.description: A self-paced course that teaches you to draw up and read Energy Grids for yourself, friends or clients, with occasional live question-and-answer classes.

courses.title: Kundalini Yoga Classes over Zoom
courses.description: A monthly membership for her two live Kundalini yoga classes a week on Zoom, plus libraries of past class recordings and an introductory video series. A sliding scale is offered.
courses.price: $40 a month (or $30 or $20 a month, sliding scale)

courses.title: The Spiritual Path of Tantra
courses.description: An eight-week online course on tantra as a spiritual path for daily life rather than a bedroom technique. Modules look at presence, time, the meditative mind and living from inner truth.

courses.title: Living in Masculine & Feminine Union
courses.description: A ten-week online course on the interplay of masculine and feminine qualities in work, love and creativity, for people of any gender. Each module pairs recorded teachings with reflection.

courses.title: Tantra for Two: A 12-Week Lovemaking Journey for Couples
courses.description: A twelve-week home course for couples that builds week by week through touch, breath, presence and communication. Each module comes with teaching videos, private practice for the two of you and email support.

courses.title: Foundations for Tantric Intimacy
courses.description: An eight-week online course for people studying on their own, whether single or with a partner who is not taking part. It introduces tantric touch, breath and meditation as ways to deepen intimacy.

courses.title: The Radiant Woman
courses.description: An eight-week online journey into the divine feminine for women, covering inner balance, intuition and relationships. It can be taken at your own pace, with a live run planned for early 2027.

free_resources.title: Katrina Bos on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Her Insight Timer page gathers guided meditations and short talks drawn from tantra and Kundalini yoga, free to listen to in the app or browser.

free_resources.title: Free Introduction to Kundalini Yoga
free_resources.description: A free package of ten short videos on the ideas behind Kundalini yoga, plus three full class recordings to follow at home. It is sent by email after you sign up.

flags: The email katrina@katrinabos.ca is the target of a visible 'send me a quick email HERE' button on her Goderich classes page rather than printed as text; the same page prints katrinabos1@gmail.com (Cloudflare-obfuscated) as the e-transfer address. A contact form is at katrinabos.ca/contact if a human prefers that.
Insight Timer lists her in Toronto, but her own sites show in-person classes and sessions in Goderich, Ontario (MacKay Centre), so the base is set to Goderich.
WebFetch would only quote the first sentence of her Insight Timer bio; the bio check relies mainly on her own site pages.
Much of her teaching is about tantric sexuality and intimacy; descriptions are kept non-explicit, and a reviewer may want to confirm the tone suits the directory.
The Zoom membership page states '$40 per month' without a currency; her other prices are in CAD.
Her YouTube channel page shows no view counts, so videos were picked as evergreen teaching talks from the latest uploads rather than by views.
